{"apiVersion":"argoproj.io/v1alpha1","kind":"WorkflowTemplate","metadata":{"annotations":{"argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id":"argo-workflows-ns-iad-ci:argoproj.io/WorkflowTemplate:argo-workflows/seam-retirement-evaluator-verify-openbao"},"labels":{"app":"seam-retirement-evaluator","component":"openbao-verification"},"name":"seam-retirement-evaluator-verify-openbao","namespace":"argo-workflows"},"spec":{"entrypoint":"verify-evaluator-access","templates":[{"container":{"args":["set -e

OPENBAO_ADDR="http://openbao.external-secrets.svc.cluster.local:8200"
export VAULT_ADDR=$OPENBAO_ADDR

log "=== OpenBao Access Verification for seam-retirement-evaluator ==="

# Check if we can reach OpenBao
if ! bao status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  error "Cannot reach OpenBao at $OPENBAO_ADDR"
fi

log "OpenBao is reachable"

# Read Kubernetes service account token
if [ ! -f "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token" ]; then
  error "Not running in Kubernetes cluster"
fi

SA_TOKEN=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)
SA_NS=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace)
SA_NAME=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/name)

log "Running as ServiceAccount: $SA_NAME in namespace: $SA_NS"

if [ "$SA_NAME" != "seam-retirement-evaluator" ]; then
  log "WARNING: Not running as seam-retirement-evaluator SA, trying anyway..."
fi

# Test Kubernetes authentication
log "Testing Kubernetes authentication to OpenBao..."
AUTH_RESPONSE=$(bao write -field=client_token auth/kubernetes/login role=seam-retirement-evaluator jwt="$SA_TOKEN" 2>&1)

if [ $? -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$AUTH_RESPONSE" ]; then
  error "Failed to authenticate via Kubernetes auth: $AUTH_RESPONSE"
fi

log "Successfully authenticated to OpenBao"

# Test 1: Read evaluator's own GitHub token from dedicated evaluators path
log "Test 1: Verifying evaluator can read own GitHub token..."
TOKEN_TEST=$(bao kv get -field=token secret/evaluators/seam-retirement-evaluator/github-token 2>&1)

if echo "$TOKEN_TEST" | grep -qi "permission denied\|Invalid"; then
  error "FAIL: Cannot read own GitHub token at secret/evaluators/seam-retirement-evaluator/github-token"
elif echo "$TOKEN_TEST" | grep -qi "REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_GITHUB_PAT"; then
  log "WARNING: GitHub token path exists but contains placeholder"
  log "This is expected during initial setup - update with actual token"
  TOKEN_EXISTS=false
else
  log "PASS: Can read own GitHub token path"
  TOKEN_EXISTS=true
fi

# Test 2: Try to read SEAM routes (should fail)
log "Test 2: Verifying SEAM routes are inaccessible..."
SEAM_TEST=$(bao kv get secret/seam/routes/ 2>&1 || true)

if echo "$SEAM_TEST" | grep -qi "permission denied\|deny"; then
  log "PASS: SEAM routes are correctly inaccessible"
elif echo "$SEAM_TEST" | grep -qi "Invalid"; then
  log "PASS: SEAM routes path is inaccessible (path doesn't exist or access denied)"
else
  error "FAIL: Can access SEAM routes - this is a security violation!"
fi

# Test 3: Check VictoriaMetrics credentials access
log "Test 3: Checking VictoriaMetrics credentials access..."
VM_TEST=$(bao kv get secret/monitoring/victoriametrics/readonly-credentials 2>&1 || true)

if echo "$VM_TEST" | grep -qi "permission denied\|Invalid"; then
  error "FAIL: Cannot read VictoriaMetrics credentials at secret/monitoring/victoriametrics/readonly-credentials"
else
  log "PASS: Can read VictoriaMetrics credentials"
fi

# Test 4: Verify policy boundaries
log "Test 4: Verifying policy boundaries..."
# Try to read something else (should fail)
OTHER_TEST=$(bao kv get secret/armor/ 2>&1 || true)
if echo "$OTHER_TEST" | grep -qi "permission denied\|Invalid"; then
  log "PASS: Correctly denied access to other paths (armor/)"
else
  error "FAIL: Can access other secret paths - policy too permissive!"
fi

# Summary
log "=== Verification Results ==="
log "✓ Evaluator ServiceAccount can authenticate to OpenBao"
if [ "$TOKEN_EXISTS" = true ]; then
  log "✓ Evaluator can read own GitHub token"
else
  log "⚠ Evaluator GitHub token path exists but contains placeholder"
fi
log "✓ Evaluator cannot read SEAM routes (isolation verified)"
log "✓ Evaluator can read VictoriaMetrics credentials"
log "✓ Evaluator policy correctly bounded (cannot access other paths)"

log "=== All verification tests passed ==="
log "Setup is ready for seam-retirement-evaluator deployment"
